CompressImagePage.title: Compress Image
CompressImagePage.description: Shrink JPG, PNG, WEBP, and TIFF file sizes while keeping the quality. Process multiple images at once.
CompressImagePage.qualityHint: Lower values reduce file size but also lower image quality.

faq.q: Does compressing an image reduce quality a lot?
faq.a: Use the quality slider to balance file size and quality yourself. Around 70-80% usually looks nearly identical while cutting the file size significantly.

faq.q: How do I meet a file size limit for a government or official submission?
faq.a: Lower the quality setting until the output is under the required size. Most limits (2MB, 5MB, etc.) can be met with around 70% quality.

faq.q: I need to shrink photos for email or messaging apps with attachment size limits.
faq.a: Yes, upload multiple images at once and compress them all to your chosen quality in one go — the results download together as a ZIP.

ResizeImagePage.title: Resize Image
ResizeImagePage.description: Resize images to any pixel size or percentage. Process multiple images at once.
ResizeImagePage.percentHint: Below 100 shrinks the image, above 100 enlarges it.
ResizeImagePage.keepAspectLabel: Keep original aspect ratio (leaving one field blank auto-calculates it)

faq.q: How do I resize a photo to a specific print size like a passport photo?
faq.a: Switch to pixel mode and enter the exact width and height you need — for example, passport photos are commonly around 413x531px.

faq.q: Can I resize an image to fit Instagram profile or story dimensions?
faq.a: Yes, just enter the exact pixel size you need (e.g. 320x320px for a profile photo, 1080x1920px for a story).

faq.q: Can I resize multiple photos to the same size at once?
faq.a: Yes, upload several images and they'll all be resized with the same settings, then downloaded together as a ZIP.

CropImagePage.title: Crop Image
CropImagePage.description: Crop images to any area by specifying pixel coordinates.

faq.q: How do I crop a photo into a square, like for a profile picture?
faq.a: Enter the same value for width and height to get a perfect square, and set the X/Y coordinates for the area you want to keep.

faq.q: Can I cut out just the background I don't want from a photo?
faq.a: Yes, specify the X/Y position and width/height of the area you want to keep, and everything outside it is removed.

faq.q: Can I crop using exact pixel coordinates?
faq.a: Yes, you can set the exact X/Y starting point and width/height in pixels for precise cropping.

ConvertImagePage.title: Convert Image
ConvertImagePage.description: Convert freely between JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, and TIFF. Process multiple images at once.

faq.q: What happens to transparency when I convert PNG to JPG?
faq.a: JPG doesn't support transparency, so any transparent areas are filled in with a white background.

faq.q: Can I convert a GIF into a still image?
faq.a: Yes, converting a GIF to PNG or JPG saves its first frame as a static image.

faq.q: Why would I convert an image to WEBP for my website?
faq.a: WEBP files are usually smaller than JPG or PNG at the same quality, which helps your website load faster.

RotateImagePage.title: Rotate Image
RotateImagePage.description: Rotate images to any angle or flip them horizontally/vertically. Process multiple images at once.

faq.q: My scanned photo is sideways — how do I straighten it?
faq.a: Choose a 90, 180, or 270 degree rotation to instantly straighten it to the orientation you need.

faq.q: Can I flip a photo horizontally to create a mirror image?
faq.a: Yes, the flip horizontal option mirrors the image left-to-right. Flip vertical is also available separately.

faq.q: My phone photos keep saving in the wrong orientation — can this fix that?
faq.a: Yes, rotate it to the correct angle and save the new version, and the orientation will stay fixed from then on.

WatermarkImagePage.title: Add Watermark
WatermarkImagePage.description: Add a text watermark to an image with adjustable opacity and position.
WatermarkImagePage.error: Something went wrong while adding the watermark.

faq.q: I want to add a copyright watermark to my photos.
faq.a: Enter your watermark text and adjust its position, opacity, and font size to style it exactly how you want.

faq.q: Can I fine-tune the watermark's opacity and position?
faq.a: Yes, use the opacity slider and the 9-position placement grid to control it precisely.

faq.q: I want to stop people from reusing my photos without credit.
faq.a: Yes, adding a visible watermark helps mark ownership and discourages unauthorized use.

MemeGeneratorPage.title: Meme Generator
MemeGeneratorPage.description: Add top and bottom text to quickly create a meme image.
MemeGeneratorPage.error: Something went wrong while generating the meme.

faq.q: Can I add caption-style text to a meme image?
faq.a: Yes, type your text into the top and bottom fields and it's added in bold, white-outlined meme-style lettering automatically.

faq.q: Can I use just a top or bottom caption instead of both?
faq.a: Yes, filling in only the top or bottom field still works fine.

faq.q: Can I download the finished meme right away?
faq.a: Yes, clicking the make button downloads your finished meme immediately.

RemoveExifPage.title: Remove Metadata
RemoveExifPage.description: Strip location and device info (EXIF) from your photos to protect your privacy. Process multiple images at once.
RemoveExifPage.infoText: GPS location, camera model, capture date, and other hidden data embedded in your photos will all be removed. Image quality and orientation stay the same.
RemoveExifPage.error: Something went wrong while removing metadata.

faq.q: I want to remove the location (GPS) data embedded in a photo.
faq.a: The metadata removal tool strips all EXIF data, including GPS location, device model, and capture date.

faq.q: I'm worried my location shows up in photos I post for online marketplace listings.
faq.a: Yes, processing a photo with this tool removes all embedded metadata, including location, so it's safe to share.

faq.q: Does removing metadata change the photo's quality or orientation?
faq.a: No, image quality and orientation stay exactly the same — only the hidden metadata is removed.

MergeImagesPage.title: Merge Images
MergeImagesPage.description: Combine multiple images into one, arranged horizontally, vertically, or in a grid.

faq.q: I want to combine several photos into one image to post on social media.
faq.a: Yes, upload multiple images and choose a horizontal, vertical, or grid layout to merge them into one.

faq.q: Can I make a collage out of multiple photos?
faq.a: Yes, choosing the grid layout automatically arranges your photos into a collage-style grid.

faq.q: Can I adjust the spacing between images?
faq.a: Yes, use the gap setting to control the spacing between images anywhere from 0 to 40px.

ContactPage.title: Contact Us
ContactPage.description: If you have any questions, bug reports, or feature suggestions, please reach out.
ContactPage.body: We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

items.a: Yes, all 9 tools are completely free and no account is required.

items.q: Do I need to sign up?
items.a: No, you can use every feature right away without signing up.

items.q: What happens to my uploaded images?
items.a: They're processed on the server and deleted automatically right afterward - nothing is stored.
